controls.title: MANUFACTURE with no product scope (single-product label)
controls.premise: The label has exactly one product, and an establishment asserts MANUFACTURE without naming any product code.
controls.expectation: The product's manufacturing_status is NO_MANUFACTURE_EVIDENCE (ONLY_UNSCOPED_OPERATIONS_IN_DOCUMENT); the MANUFACTURE edge is UNKNOWN with reason scope:no_product_scope and product_pk NULL.
controls.trap: The tempting inference 'there is only one product, so the unscoped MANUFACTURE must be for it'. The rule does not make it; this control pins that.

controls.title: MANUFACTURE by an unresolved DUNS
controls.premise: The only MANUFACTURE assertion for the product names a DUNS absent from every loaded FDA registration file.
controls.expectation: manufacturing_status UNKNOWN_SITE; the edge is UNKNOWN with reason identity:NOT_FOUND; no FEI; never DIRECT.
controls.trap: Promoting an unregistered DUNS to a physical site on the strength of the SPL alone.
